label: SDRplay (RSP1A / RSPdx / RSPduo)
notes: IF filter picked as the largest ladder entry ≤ Fs. SDRplay's own default of 200 kHz brick-walls the spectrum at ±100 kHz, and any filter wider than Fs makes the driver silently upclock Fs — so we pick from the ladder explicitly rather than leaving it to the driver. Advertised max of 10.66 MS/s fails activateStream in practice; clamped to 10 MS/s. `rfgain_sel` hidden from the advanced panel because it duplicates the `RFGR` gain element (same LNA state, two Soapy surfaces).
